evidence_only_guard: Hebrew syntax, discourse formulas, parallelism, rare words, Masoretic sections, qere/ketiv, MT-LXX-DSS pressure, speaker shifts, poetry, liturgical annotations, and internal reuse are boundary evidence only. They select no preferred text, translation, speaker, identity, date, fulfillment, ethics, canon, or theology. Roots are not meanings; context controls. Agreement is evidence, never authority.

global_holds.witnesses: OSHB and UXLC are correlated Masoretic/Leningrad-family evidence, not independent ancient votes. MT, Greek Twelve, 1QpHab and other Judean-desert fragments where extant, Syriac, Vulgate, Targum, and later witnesses expose pressure but establish no preferred reading. 1QpHab embeds interpretation, is not boundary or theology authority, and does not provide equivalent Habakkuk 3 control.
global_holds.versification: English 56-verse coordinates are fixed. Masoretic sections and accents, Selah, USFM paragraphs, ancient layouts, and chapters are evidence only.
global_holds.speech: Prophetic I, Yahweh, hearers, violent agent, taunt speakers, woe addressee, prayer voice, people-anointed, and invader suffixes remain LOW where ambiguous.
global_holds.internal_relations: Torah, exodus and sea poetry, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Nahum, Zephaniah, the Twelve, and later reuse are evidence only; no direction, fulfillment, identity, doctrine, or seam authority.
global_holds.ethics_theology_history: Chaldean history, violence, divine agency, justice, exposure, animals, cult, theophany, salvation, anointed language, chronology, fulfillment, and modern application are not adjudicated.
global_holds.confidence_policy: Every boundary is LOW and deferred_human_or_external_ai.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hammassa, asher chazah, Habakkuk, and hannavi form a title before direct lament.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Nominal syntax differs from the interrogative address in Hab.1.2.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: How-long complaint over violence and distorted justice
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Ad-anah and lamah questions accumulate hamas, conflict, torah, and mishpat to doubled al-ken.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split conditions from verdict or merge the divine answer.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: First-person appeal and question-result logic cohere; plural imperatives reset Hab.1.5.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Plural imperatives and ki open the answer; hineni meqim introduces the nation, horses, captives, kings, fortress, wind, and guilt/strength catalogue.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Hab.1.5, atomize images, or resolve Hab.1.11 into the next complaint.
proposed_chunks.risk: Hab.1.5 Vorlage; identity; violence; Hab.1.11 syntax.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Third-person plural suffixes and motion verbs carry the announced work to a terminal textual crux.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Second complaint with fish and net comparison
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Halo attah miqqedem reopens first-person address; pure-eye question expands through fish, hook, net, dragnet, sacrifice, food, and final question.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split address, net catalogue, or at the chapter edge.
proposed_chunks.risk: Lo namut; pronouns; metaphor; divine agency.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Second-person divine address frames one unanswered complaint.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Watch, stand, set, look, what-he-will-say, and what-I-will-answer stage the response.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Absorb into complaint or written vision.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: First-person posture verbs form a threshold before wayyaaneni YHWH.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayyaaneni YHWH, write and make-plain, appointed vision, waiting, hinneh contrast, and insatiable portrait form the taunt prologue.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Proof-text Hab.2.4, detach Hab.2.5, or merge the first hoy.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Answer and vision lexemes govern; Hab.2.5 supplies the taunt antecedent.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Taunt introduction and first woe: plunder reversed
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Mashal, melitsah, and hidot introduce quoted hoy; creditors and shalal reversal close the movement.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate the heading or rare pledge term.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Question-to-hoy syntax and plunder repetition bind the unit.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Second woe: unjust house gain and stone-beam witness
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Renewed hoy; house, nest, and escape turn to shame, stone cry, and kafis answer.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split nest, shame, or building testimony.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Repeated bayit and building components make the refuge accuse itself.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Third woe: blood-city and earth-filling counterimage
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hoy boneh opens; building, labor, fire, and emptiness turn to earth filled and waters covering sea.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Hab.2.14 or decide prophetic source direction.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Build-labor-empty versus fill-cover forms one reversal; samekh closes.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Fourth woe: exposure reversed through cup and violence
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hoy mashqeh opens; drink and gaze turn through shame/glory, drink-you-too, cup, and Lebanon, animal, land, and city violence.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split exposure, cup reversal, or rationale.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Drink, gaze, shame-glory, and violence lexical chains bind accusation through rationale.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Fifth anti-idol woe and temple hush
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Mah-hoil questions image and maker; hoy addresses wood and stone, no-spirit contrast, and YHWH-in-temple answers with whole-earth hush.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Hab.2.18, split mute contrast, or isolate the hush.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Speech and muteness culminate in terminal hush and petuhah.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Tefillah le-Habakkuk hannavi al shigyonot is compact nominal metadata.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Absorb into petition or reconstruct performance.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Nominal metadata differs from the vocative in Hab.3.2.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Petition to renew and remember mercy
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Repeated YHWH, shamati and yareti, then hayyehu, todia, and rahem imperatives form a concise petition.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: First-person hearing and second-person imperatives precede third-person advent.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Eloah from Teman opens; Selah, splendor, qarnayim, plague terms, standing, mountains, and Cushan-Midian carry the movement.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split images or reconstruct an itinerary.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Third-person advent and land-tent reactions cohere; samekh precedes river questions.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: River interrogation, weapons, cosmic response, and salvation climax
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Triple river-sea question resets to second person; chariots, bow, waters, sun-moon, marching, and repeated salvation culminate at Selah.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Second-person warrior verbs progress to repeated salvation purpose; Selah and petuhah mark closure.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Second-person naqabeta and darakhta continue action through attackers, first-person object, horses, sea, and waters before shamati.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Merge across Selah, split the verses, or resolve qere-ketiv.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Two second-person perfects form a coda; Hab.3.16 returns to first-person body response.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Trembling, waiting, crop-failure condition, confidence, and music close
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Shamati and body trembling lead through waiting, ki agricultural negations, wa-ani rejoicing, divine strength, hind feet, and lamnatseah colophon.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Hab.3.16, atomize crops, proof-text the close, or separate the colophon.
proposed_chunks.risk: Waiting syntax; invader; crop terms; performance; theology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Hearing, conditions, adversative resolve, and strength conclusion form one speaker-centered close.
